mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_audit_log (out_trade_no, action, from_status, to_status, success, detail, create_time) VALUES (#{outTradeNo}, #{action}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{success}, #{detail}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, out_trade_no, action, from_status, to_status, success, detail, create_time FROM payment_audit_log WHERE out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT o.out_trade_no FROM payment_order o WHERE o.status IN ('PAID', 'FINISHED') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment_audit_log l WHERE l.out_trade_no = o.out_trade_no AND l.action IN ('PAY', 'NOTIFY') ) LIMIT 200
